verdict.rationale: Aircall's own marketing says calls, SMS and messaging stay connected to the CRM, and that its AI Assistants update CRM records automatically. However, the evidence is only high-level homepage copy, with no documentation of specific native CRM integrations or of how activities are matched to the correct contact. Missing for 10: documented native CRM integrations (named CRMs, setup), explicit automatic call and SMS activity logging behavior, contact-matching logic against the right record, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts log to my CRM automatically against the right contact

citations.quote: Calls, SMS, and messaging live in one platform, keeping every interaction connected to your CRM, help desk, and business tools.
AI Assistants capture notes, update CRM records, and create follow-up tasks automatically
logging the outcome in your CRM
